title: Strings that only YAML 1.1 reads as another type are set plain over a plain string
notes: Under the core schema these four are strings (YAML 1.2.2 section 10.3.2), so the plain style of the replaced value can hold them and keeps them; quoting them for a YAML 1.1 reader is for `dump`, not for an edit (docs/edit-semantics.md). `edit/set-plain-string-yes-stays-plain-in-core` is the same rule over a number. The exact bytes rest on a kit convention.

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the same texts added as new members were written single-quoted by the native backend (`edit/add-strings-that-yaml-1-1-reads-as-other-types-stay-plain-in-core`).
